violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CDI: CFM ARRIVED.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED A GREEN SCRUB IN THE HANDWASHING SINK NEXT TO THE THREE-VAT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: SCRUB REMOVED, PIC RE-EDUCATED.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED NACHO CHEESE IN DISPENSERS AT 105–113F (2HR).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI: WATER ADDED TO DISPENSER AND DISPENSER TEMPERATURE INCREASED. **ALL OF THE TCS FOOD MUST BE 135F NOT JUST THE BOTTOM OF THE CONTAINER**

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED MILK AT 50F AND WHIPPED CREAM AT 58F IN THE ONE-DOOR RESIDENTIAL COOLER BY CASH REGISTER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: FOOD DISPOSED OF. CEASE HOLDING TCS FOODS IN THIS UNIT IF IT CANNOT HOLD TCS FOODS AT 41F OR BELOW.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: OBSERVED DELI HAM THAWING IN CONTAINER OF TEPID WATER IN PREP-SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. CDI: HAM MOVED TO COOLER DURING INSPECTION. CHARLEYS CHEESESTEAKS WINGS (Inspection Date: 09/16/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cheese in Triboxer 2dr. Prep, 45F (2hrs) and wings, 60F (from this morning).
violations.corrective_action: Cheese was relocated for rapid cooling and chicken wings were discarded. Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food observed stored on the floor in the walk-in freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Please have your employees continue to place shelving in the walk-in freezer. Provide approved shelving- Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Mop sink system observed under constant pressure with the wrong backflow device installed.
violations.corrective_action: Splitter was disconnected. Please install a pressure bleeding device as discussed. A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14.
